title: August Melts
author: Bijayalaxmi Rath
text:
August melts in heavenly shower.
Tender authority of damp and drench
hums muddy musty love.
Fades soft pain of void and obscure.
Scribbled Earth`s poems of pain and pride.

Drowsy evening steps towards wild
sensational night.
Some depart, a few meet.
Vanishes petrichor.
Mold lichen bubble in their fragrance best.

Different syllables whispers wind.
Truth of soul basks at the mild sunrise.
Sometimes a bit of moon.
Sometimes shimmer of stars.
Shift the shrinking heart to the
drenched green love.
Hope carried through out.

Flowers and orchids celebrate supremacy.
Wings of optimism unfolds to the cool
ecstatic splash.
Footsteps of buried and beneath slowly
drink the dissolved elixir to fall in love
with life.
Melts August portion by portion.
Centre holds all the fallen aparts.
